def ridge_test(X, lam):
    Xs=X  # raw activations
    tr=(tmpl==0)&(isvel|isoth); te=(tmpl==5)&(isvel|isoth)
    Y=np.zeros((128,30)); Y[isvel,factidx[isvel]]=1
    # add general rows to training as negatives
    trg=tr|(np.array([m[0]=='gen' for m in exmeta]))
    A=Xs[trg]; B=Y[trg]
    W=np.linalg.solve(A.T@A+lam*np.eye(A.shape[1]),A.T@B)
    P=Xs@W
    vt=te&isvel; ot=te&isoth
    corr=P[vt,factidx[vt]].mean(); oth_same=P[ot,factidx[ot]].mean()
    acc=(np.argmax(P[vt],1)==factidx[vt]).mean()
    return corr,oth_same,acc
for nm in X_final:

    out=[ridge_test(X, lam*sc) for lam in [0.01,0.1]]

def dprime_heldout(X):

    # whiten with pooled within-class covariance (ridge) from training rows
    Xc=np.concatenate([X[tr&isvel]-X[tr&isvel].mean(0), X[tr&isoth]-X[tr&isoth].mean(0)])
    Cw=Xc.T@Xc/len(Xc); lam=np.trace(Cw)/Cw.shape[0]

H23e=np.load(d14+'hidden_23.npy',mmap_mode='r'); A23e=np.load(d14+'mlp_act_23.npy',mmap_mode='r')
# map rec1 rows in pass 9 (r1_b0) to same positions in pass 14

# Hypothesis: refitting the J down-columns on the ACTUAL J activations (closed-form LS) fixes the training fit and generalizes to held-out templates.
Vrows=[]  # (pass, row, pos, offset, fact, tmpl)
JA=[]; KIc=[]; KLc=[]; YY=[]; LPc=[]; RMSc=[]
for b,k in enumerate([14,15]):
    dd=f'/work/fwd_{k}/'; t_=np.load(dd+'token_ids.npy'); lp_=np.load(dd+'token_logprobs.npy').astype(np.float32)
    ki=np.load(dd+'topk_ids.npy'); kl=np.load(dd+'topk_logprobs.npy').astype(np.float32)
    A23=np.load(dd+'mlp_act_23.npy',mmap_mode='r'); H23c=np.load(dd+'hidden_23.npy',mmap_mode='r')
    Ls=(t_>=0).sum(1)
    for r in range(128):
        gi=b*128+r; m=r1m[gi]; ids=t_[r,:Ls[r]].tolist()
        th=[i for i,x in enumerate(ids) if tok.decode([x])=='</think>'][-1]; st=th+2; en=Ls[r]-2
        for p in range(st-1,en):
            Vrows.append((k,r,p,p-(st-1),m[1],m[2])); JA.append(np.array(A23[r,p,J],dtype=np.float32))
            KIc.append(ki[r,p]); KLc.append(kl[r,p]); YY.append(ids[p+1]); LPc.append(float(lp_[r,p+1]))
            RMSc.append(np.linalg.norm(H23c[r,p].astype(np.float32))/32)
JA=np.stack(JA); KIc=np.stack(KIc); KLc=np.stack(KLc); YY=np.array(YY); LPc=np.array(LPc); RMSc=np.array(RMSc)
V_off=np.array([v[3] for v in Vrows]); V_tm=np.array([v[5] for v in Vrows]); V_fact=np.array([v[4] for v in Vrows])
def need_delta(i,M):
    p=np.exp(KLc[i]); p/=p.sum(); ebar=p@E[KIc[i]]
    others=[KLc[i][k] for k in range(20) if KIc[i][k]!=YY[i]]; best_o=max(others)
    need=max(0.0,M-(LPc[i]-best_o)); u=G*(E[YY[i]]-ebar); return need*RMSc[i]*u/(u@u)
def fit_down(rows_fit,M=4.0,lam=1.0,w0=3.0):
    out_cur=JA@Wdn
    T=np.stack([need_delta(i,M) for i in range(len(JA))])+out_cur
    sw=np.where(V_off==0,w0,1.0)[rows_fit][:,None]
    A=JA[rows_fit]*sw; B=T[rows_fit]*sw
    return np.linalg.solve(A.T@A+lam*np.eye(len(J)),A.T@B)
def eval_cur(Wnew, rows):
    out=JA[rows]@(Wnew-Wdn); res=[]
    for n,i in enumerate(np.where(rows)[0]):
        cand=list(KIc[i]); base=list(KLc[i])
        if YY[i] not in cand: cand.append(YY[i]); base.append(LPc[i])
        cand=np.array(cand); base=np.array(base); new=base+E[cand]@(G*out[n])/RMSc[i]; yi=list(cand).index(YY[i])
        res.append(new[yi]-np.max(np.delete(new,yi)))
    return np.array(res)
trv=np.isin(V_tm,[0,1,2,3,4,5]); tev=~trv
for lam in [0.1,1,10]:
    Wn=fit_down(trv,lam=lam)
    a=eval_cur(Wn,tev&(V_off==0)); b=eval_cur(Wn,tev&(V_off>0)); c=eval_cur(Wn,trv&(V_off==0))
    print(lam,'train first %.2f | heldout first %.2f (med %.1f) | heldout cont %.2f | |Wdn| %.1f'%((c>0).mean(),(a>0).mean(),np.median(a),(b>0).mean(),np.linalg.norm(Wn)))

# Hypothesis: build a sharpened (quadratic, bias-free) marker: refit L10 detector with corpus negatives, write it weakly into an inert dir r_m, and let one repurposed L11 neuron square it into the marker m.
# 1) detector refit with all negatives
A=Kv_all.T@Kv_all+1.0*(Ko_all.T@Ko_all+Kb10.T@Kb10)+1.0*np.eye(3584,dtype=np.float32)
w10n=np.linalg.solve(A,Kv_all.sum(0)); del A
sV=Kv_all@w10n; sB=Kb10@w10n
print('new detector in-sample: V mean %.2f min %.2f | corpus frac>0.1 %.4f max %.2f'%(sV.mean(),sV.min(),(sB>0.1).mean(),sB.max()))
# 2) inert direction r_m for layers 11-23 (+ logits, + low variance at h12/h16)
terms_m=[]
def add_t(M): terms_m.append(M/(np.trace(M)/M.shape[0]))
for l in range(11,24):
    p_=f'model.language_model.layers.{l}.'
    win=ln_w(p_+'input_layernorm.weight'); wpo=ln_w(p_+'post_attention_layernorm.weight')
    if l in (11,15,19,23):
        R=np.concatenate([load(p_+f'self_attn.{n}_proj.weight').numpy() for n in ['q','k','v']],0)*win[None,:]; Wo=load(p_+'self_attn.o_proj.weight').numpy()
    else:
        R=np.concatenate([load(p_+f'linear_attn.{n}.weight').numpy() for n in ['in_proj_qkv','in_proj_z','in_proj_a','in_proj_b']],0)*win[None,:]; Wo=load(p_+'linear_attn.out_proj.weight').numpy()
    add_t(R.T@R); add_t(Wo@Wo.T)
    Rm=np.concatenate([load(p_+'mlp.gate_proj.weight').numpy(),load(p_+'mlp.up_proj.weight').numpy()],0)*wpo[None,:]; add_t(Rm.T@Rm)
    Wd_=load(p_+'mlp.down_proj.weight').numpy(); add_t(Wd_@Wd_.T)
del R,Wo,Rm,Wd_; gc.collect()

def fit_prior(Xv,Xn,w_old,eps,tN=-1.0):
    wN=np.ones(trN.sum(),np.float32); wV=np.full(trV.sum(),trN.sum()/trV.sum(),np.float32)
    A=np.concatenate([Xv[trV]*np.sqrt(wV)[:,None],Xn[trN]]); b=np.concatenate([np.ones(trV.sum())*np.sqrt(wV),np.full(trN.sum(),tN)]).astype(np.float32)
    b=b-A@w_old
    return w_old+np.linalg.solve(A.T@A+eps*np.eye(3584,dtype=np.float32),A.T@b)

    ki=np.load(dd+'topk_ids.npy'); kl=np.load(dd+'topk_logprobs.npy').astype(np.float32)
    A23=np.load(dd+'mlp_act_23.npy',mmap_mode='r'); H23c=np.load(dd+'hidden_23.npy',mmap_mode='r'); Ls=(t_>=0).sum(1)
    out=dict(rows=[],JA=[],KI=[],KL=[],Y=[],LP=[],RMS=[])

        st=ths[-1]+2; ps=list(range(st-1,Ls[r]-2)) if V_mask_fn(m) else list(range(1,Ls[r]-1))
        out['JA'].append(np.array(A23[r,ps][:,J],dtype=np.float32)); out['KI'].append(ki[r,ps]); out['KL'].append(kl[r,ps])
